page_title: FUL 3-2 WOL | Fulham v Wolves 27/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+11' Harrison Reed (Fulham) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
90+11' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+8' Mario Lemina (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Salisbury interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+7' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Cairney trots off the pitch and is replaced by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
90+5' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) replaces Willian.
90+4' 3 - 2 Goal! Willian (Fulham) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jose Sa into the bottom left corner.
90+4' Willian (Fulham) is going to take the penalty!
90+3' The Fulham players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+1' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Fulham! Let's see what he decides.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' PENALTY APPEAL after Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
89' Joao Gomes (Wolves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
88' The expression of the referee Michael Salisbury is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) is shown a yellow card.
88' Max Kilman (Wolves) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
86' A pass by Harry Wilson (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
84' The foul by Mario Lemina (Wolves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Salisbury.
83' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matheus Cunha.
83' Willian (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is behind the touchline and Fulham will take a throw-in.
82' Harrison Reed (Fulham) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
80' The foul by Harry Wilson (Fulham) was seen by Michael Salisbury who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
79' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa has it covered and makes a comfortable save.

77' Tom Cairney (Fulham) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
76' Here is a change. Raul Jimenez is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Vinicius (Fulham).
76' It's time for a substitution. Harry Wilson (Fulham) comes on in place of Andreas Pereira.
75' 2 - 2 Goal! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Bernd Leno.
75' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

74' Tim Ream (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Salisbury no option but to blow his whistle. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Wolves!
69' A pass from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is intercepted by Jose Sa and the move breaks down.
69' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andreas Pereira (Fulham).

69' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Jose Sa makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle after Santiago Bueno (Wolves) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
64' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a long ball forward to Willian, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
62' That will be all from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).
59' 2 - 1 Goal! Willian (Fulham) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jose Sa to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
59' Willian (Fulham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
58' It’s a PENALTY to Fulham after the VAR review!
57' There's a break in play and referee Michael Salisbury must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Fulham using VAR. This could be interesting!
56' Poor challenge! Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is penalised for tripping and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle. It's a penalty for Fulham!

55' Mario Lemina (Wolves) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
55' Joao Gomes (Wolves) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

54' Matt Doherty (Wolves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play and Wolves manage to earn a corner.
52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
51' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Fulham earn a corner.
50' Matt Doherty (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
49' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Mario Lemina (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno easily deals with the threat.
47' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the right post is denied by a decent save from Bernd Leno.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Willian (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
40' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
40' Willian (Fulham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
38' Toti (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Michael Salisbury signals a foul.
37' Toti (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' Joao Gomes (Wolves) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
36' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
36' Tom Cairney (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
34' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
34' Fulham have a free kick.
33' The whistle blows and Joao Gomes (Wolves) is booked for an infringement.
30' Willian (Fulham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jose Sa is quickest to intercept the ball.
29' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
28' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) but poses no threat. The ball has crossed the sideline. Fulham are taking a throw-in.
27' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
26' Matt Doherty (Wolves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

22' 1 - 1 Goal! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde hands Matheus Cunha (Wolves) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
19' Rayan Ait Nouri is being substituted because of an injury. Gary O'Neil sends Matt Doherty (Wolves) on the pitch.
19' What was Tim Ream (Fulham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
16' The resulting corner, taken by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), comes to nothing.
16' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
15' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
14' The game is interrupted now, Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
12' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jose Sa.
11' Mario Lemina (Wolves) jumps into a tackle and Michael Salisbury signals a foul.
10' Tom Cairney (Fulham) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
10' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

9' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed to the bottom left corner, but it lacks power and Jose Sa pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
7' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Antonee Robinson laid the ball off to Alex Iwobi (Fulham), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
4' Harrison Reed (Fulham) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
2' Michael Salisbury blows for a foul after Raul Jimenez (Fulham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' A pass by Andreas Pereira (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
